"""Differential test of the documented pattern dialect against Python's re."""
import random, re, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from eywa.regex import compile as compile_pattern

ALPHABET = "abcdefg0123456789"

def gen_pattern(rng, depth=0):
    if depth >= 3 or rng.random() < 0.25:
        ch = rng.choice(ALPHABET)
        return "[%s-%s]" % (ch, rng.choice(ALPHABET[ALPHABET.index(ch):])) \
            if rng.random() < 0.4 else ch
    choice_kind = rng.random()
    if choice_kind < 0.3:
        parts = [gen_pattern(rng, depth + 1) for _ in range(rng.randint(2, 3))]
        return "(" + "|".join(parts) + ")"
    if choice_kind < 0.7:
        parts = [gen_pattern(rng, depth + 1) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 3))]
        return "(" + "".join(parts) + ")"
    return "(" + gen_pattern(rng, depth + 1) + ")*"


def gen_string(rng):
    return "".join(rng.choice(ALPHABET) for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 8)))


rng = random.Random(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 1)
fail = 0
checked = 0
for trial in range(4000):
    pattern = gen_pattern(rng)
    ours = compile_pattern(pattern)
    try:
        theirs = re.compile(pattern)          # same semantics for this subset
    except re.error:
        continue
    for _ in range(6):
        text = gen_string(rng)
        want = theirs.fullmatch(text) is not None
        got = ours.matches(text)
        checked += 1
        if want != got:
            fail += 1
            print("MISMATCH pattern=%r text=%r ours=%s python=%s" % (
                pattern, text, got, want))
            if fail > 10:
                sys.exit(1)
print("checked", checked, "failures", fail)
PYEOF
